what: Ticket text, filed as a row because this cloud session has no tracker. Title: the host-discovery-timeout plant has no Stryker mutant. Body: the old plant case host-discovery-timeout moved runtime discovery in .agents/skills/lead/scripts/flow/host.ts out of Effect.cached, so it ran before the first line's deadline. No Stryker 10.1.1 mutator unwraps or moves a call, so @kalfa/quality/stryker cannot plant it, and 0600 allows no hand-written fallback. Its law, the host step's scenario that stalled runtime discovery shares the first command's deadline and is reaped before returning, keeps only its recorded one-time plant until a Stryker-made mutant is found (a survey of host.ts) or the law gets another proof.
cause: Stryker's mutators change expressions in place; none moves code between scopes.
fix: Run kalfa quality stryker survey over flow/host.ts with the law's file, and add the plant if a mutant the law kills is found.
test: The plant answers killed on CI.
